Selected reviewed edition. Each result retains its exact hypotheses and verification scope.

Renewed review of all 59 delivered paper records

The mathematical review passes for the exact scoped statements, with the explicit relay-domain clarification recorded below. The original delivered ZIP was not proof-complete: it removed historical drafts without replacing all their definitions and full arguments. This audit supplies complete replacement public supplements and a per-result integration map. The new candidate still requires their inclusion, rendering, links and exact final-byte review.

Scope and evidence

All 59 corrected proof texts, displayed hypotheses and supporting delivered mathematical arguments were reread. Every inferential step was assessed for domain boundaries, actual versus abstract objects, source capacities, ordering assumptions, finite-to-universal induction and use of unproved suppliers. Earlier PASS/accepted labels were not used as mathematical premises. The new supplements are full derivations, not another list of verdicts.

The 8 conditional statements retain their open quantitative/application suppliers. The 3 repaired earlier statements retain their corrections. The 3 excluded result IDs are absent from result records/pages/book sections and are not unconditionally imported into a retained proof. The source archive and donor remain untouched.

Fresh finite replay

A copied portable checker rebuilt literal rows0..810 from positive MEX/COPY. It verified C300 bases/normalized identities, lag120 closure, lag124 context/terminal replies, C360 bases and lag2111355278 support calls/505860 bases, and tight-width7..43 values. The checker branch paying the lag124 forced-Q reply is a separate written proof step; its complete new supplement is linked. Universal conclusions use the written periodic and well-founded inductions, not the finite receipt alone.

New corrections

  1. Cross-clock payload bound: an arising endpoint satisfies y>=q>=3, so y-2 is valid. For arbitrary y>=0 use max(0,y-2); no endpoint occurs for y<3. This clarifies a literal negative-bound corner rather than disproving the source injection.
  2. Charged-shell compact proof: remove the extraneous undefined T(A) pruning claim; the local Hall criterion and its precisely finite admissible class are unchanged.
  3. Fresh-permutation small-index sentence: replace garbled text; the terminal lemma guard and explicit small cases remain unchanged.
  4. Positive-response inventory sharpness: exact saturation is stated only for integer C and rational omega scaled to integer inventories. The conditional inequality for real C remains valid, with fibre cardinalities effectively bounded by floor(C); no canonical realization or exact equality for every real/irrational choice is claimed.

Delivery completeness

SUPPLEMENT-INTEGRATION.json binds every new supplement and its per-result links. INDEX.md is public navigation. The full counting service/extremizer derivations, root/A Pell and lag124 proofs, and eight own definition/model/transport supplements replace missing source material. Existing full slope and strict-liminf proofs remain linked, and the strict algebra citation must use an actually included fresh checker/receipt. No unreviewed original draft is reinstated as a proof source.
